verified_findings.claim: The evidence ledger must preserve generic and corroborating records separately.
verified_findings.source: P4 v2.3 reports 1,819 corroborations, 3,809 generic records, 128 dropped records and 115 recorded problems.
verified_findings.inference: Aggregation into one strategy label would hide epistemic disagreement.
verified_findings.decision: Keep immutable evidence separate from ontology and runtime mapping.

verified_findings.claim: Backtest claims require multiple-testing and transaction-cost controls.
verified_findings.source: Harvey and Liu discuss inflated Sharpe statistics after repeated search; execution-cost research measures heterogeneous real-world impact.
verified_findings.inference: A backtest is an experiment artifact, not evidence by itself.
verified_findings.decision: Bind search count, cost model and OOS boundary before promotion.

verified_findings.claim: Chart/VLM output is not exact market data or self-verifying evidence.
verified_findings.source: Chart reasoning evaluations report hallucination, factual error and sensitivity to absent or contradictory chart information.
verified_findings.inference: Visual fact, author interpretation and model inference must be separate.
verified_findings.decision: Reject invented prices, timeframes and OHLC values; preserve unreadable as unreadable.

verified_findings.claim: The current V8 contracts are strong on PIT state and deterministic runtime boundaries, but research-to-runtime mapping must remain versioned.
verified_findings.source: Current architecture and decision documents separate MarketState, Experts, lifecycle, RiskGate, simulator and Lab.
verified_findings.inference: Research findings must not mutate runtime definitions.
verified_findings.decision: Use versioned research annotations and proposal artifacts.

v8_changes.change: Expose pending rereads; do not equate generated findings with deep-read completion.
Keep exact text/visual spans and counterevidence immutable.
Add VisualRegion, Caption and VisualEvidence records.
Bind dataset, simulator, search count, OOS and cost model.
Add declared volatility, participation/liquidity, event-tempo and transition observables.
Add non-response, thesis deterioration, time stop, scaling and re-entry events.
Separate cluster heat, cost uncertainty and state uncertainty.
Keep BLIND_DISCOVERY_QUOTA and V8_AWARE_QUOTA receipts separate.
